⚙️ Connection details and Supabase setup

The host sets this up once, then uses COPY INVITE. A friend can open that link or paste the full invite into Join; it includes the public project settings. A three-digit code alone requires setup on both devices. No PeerJS, Trystero, WebRTC, or separate server deployment.

Create one free project at supabase.com/dashboard. Get its URL and publishable key from the project's Connect panel. Realtime public channels must be enabled. NEVER paste a secret or service_role key here. Setup is saved in this browser when storage is available. Invites include the public Project URL and publishable key. Use the same game on both devices.

  • 🏍️ You · solo
How friends join (three steps)
  1. Both devices open this same game and choose the same multiplayer system. Trystero needs no account or project setup. To try Supabase instead, select it and enter its project settings.
  2. Player 1 presses CREATE ROOM. When it says READY, press COPY INVITE and send it to your friend. Keep the host page open.
  3. Player 2 opens the invite link (or pastes the full invite into Join) and presses JOIN ROOM. When both names appear, select colors/map, then each press START RIDING.

Trystero uses public relays to find your friend and then connects the devices directly. A relay connection alone does not mean your friend has joined. Supabase is an alternative and needs a project.

Experimental friend rooms. Three-digit codes are guessable and are not private or authenticated. Keep the host page open; networks can block relays or direct device connections.
